test_datadog_callback_performance: test the datadog callback performance impact on litellm async completions by comparing run times with and without the callback
run_async_completion_load_test: run a load test that executes batches of async litellm completion calls and measures total execution time
create_async_litellm_task: create an async task that calls litellm acompletion with a mock response and specified model parameters
benchmark_litellm_callbacks: benchmark litellm success callbacks by measuring the percentage performance difference between empty and datadog callbacks
configure_datadog_environment: configure datadog environment variables including DD_API_KEY, DD_SITE, and _DATADOG_BASE_URL for litellm callback testing
